records.issue_text: groups_controller#members takes `limit` directly from params with no cap, allowing `limit=1000000` on large automatic groups to serialize every user and enable resource exhaustion
records.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit` is set from params with `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and then passed directly into `group.users...limit(limit)` with no upper bound. The endpoint now paginates all groups (not just automatic ones) and will attempt to serialize up to whatever `limit` is provided, enabling resource exhaustion if a client requests a very large limit (e.g., 1000000).

After `removeMember`, it calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`.
